summary: Independently re-derived and verified the CHGR-001 v1.1 schema-envelope/canonical-identity contract (docs/contracts/CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_CONTRACT.md Sec.26, CHGR-REQ-194 through CHGR-REQ-206) Phase 146B froze, per explicit human authorization, without trusting Phase 146A's or 146B's own narrative framing. Reconstructed the schema-envelope problem independently from primary sources: the frozen CHGR schema family (human_governance_record.schema.json and its three sibling schemas, manifest.json), PEC-001 v1.1 Sec.20, IWPC-001 v1.4 Sec.31, Phase 144G's own prior independent classification of authority_basis_claimed (docs/PHASE_144G_PROVENANCE_BOUNDARY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md Sec.9-10), and the current implementation (record.py, coordinator.py). 12 of 14 requirements (CHGR-REQ-194-198, 200-203, 205-206) independently confirmed correct, necessary, complete, consistent, and implementable. One Blocking finding, discovered independently and not inherited from any prior phase's disclosure: CHGR-REQ-199 (authority_basis_claimed SHALL remain correctly and permanently absent) and CHGR-REQ-204 (fail-closed rejection of any four-artifact construction that does not validate against human_governance_record.schema.json) cannot be jointly satisfied while that already-frozen schema's own required array (unmodified since Phase 143E) continues to list authority_basis_claimed as a mandatory top-level key with no conditional relaxation anywhere in the schema file. Consequence: every future Publication attempt would be refused by CHGR-REQ-204, permanently, for as long as no Decision Template eligible_authority model exists anywhere in this repository (the IWPC-001 Sec.31 'C-1' authority-evaluation deferral) -- a consequence Phase 146B's own Migration Strategy (Sec.26.6) did not disclose, since 146B's pre-existing, correctly-disclosed 'schema-envelope fields not yet populated' limitation (144G Sec.10, classified Non-Blocking) only became a standing contradiction once CHGR-REQ-204's own new fail-closed gate is read together with CHGR-REQ-199 and the unmodified schema. Verification only: no contract, schema, or production code modified; no implementation authorized or performed. See docs/PHASE_146C_CHGR001_SCHEMA_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
